column1: # DECLARED anchors for the flight-size livery VARIANTS (tools/art/make_livery.py --variant NAME; research LIVERY-VARIANTS-PLAN.md). SPRITES only (62x27, planes face RIGHT, (0,0) = top-left).

# FIRST DRAFT, written at the desk from the 6x contact sheet by eye, NOT checked against pixels: the script FAILS (prints every glyph/band cell that is off the drawn plane) and is corrected by editing this table, never by searching.
#   gx gy  = the centre of the globe (g5 = 5x5 with cut corners, rows gy-2..gy+2; body = the 3x3 glyph), '-' = none
#   bx0..bx1, by0..by1 = the band's cells (inclusive), '-' = none; bcol = gold | navy (the twin's fin is already gold, so its band is navy)
# A plane with no row for a variant is skipped (the body variant is only tried where the fuselage is deep enough below the windows).
